text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Kiiing!! El's birthday LANE message was 
the very first one you got this year, 
wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, right at the stroke of midnight. 
...Fufufu♪ Were you really looking forward 
to my birthday that much?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Sending it right when the day changes 
makes the message feel that much more 
special, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll send mine right on the dot 
too. Because I want to be the first one to 
congratulate King-chan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You say that now~, but come next year, 
aren't you just gonna be tap-tapping and 
erasing and tap-tapping again just like 
yesterday, yes~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't delete anything, just send 
the whole thing! Every single word is 
Grass's heartfelt feelings, after all!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to make them happy, I want 
to put my feelings into polite, carefully 
chosen words.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
HOWEVER! The one who delivered the best 
start to King's birthday this year is El's 
message!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...King-chan, you have high hopes for next 
year, okay? My message will be the first 
one to make you smile.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No way. Next year, El will be number one 
too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Did you really think I wouldn't devise a 
strategy?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What kind of contest is that even supposed 
to be? Honestly... you silly bunch.
